Hi @elarlang and @tghosth 

The OSHP project is active and content is updated as often as possible.

In addition, resources added to OSHP are monitored regarding any broken links or github repo not maintained.

Roadmap and OSHP org content are clearly defined.

All our exchange are public and we made public POC before recommending any technical content.

Regarding the alignment with the ASVS. References to OSHP were only added into ASVS sections in which security headers are mentioned. 

Feel free to ask me any question/concern regarding the OSHP content and update issue.
